title: Ivanti Avalanche EnterpriseServer Service Exposed Dangerous Function Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SetUser class. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
